slots.name: land area
slots.sentence: BrenX Ltd. (NASDAQ: BRNX ) ("BrenX" or the "Company") , formerly Brenmiller Energy Ltd., a leading provider of thermal energy storage ("TES") and integrated industrial energy solutions, today announced that its Hungarian subsidiary, A.R.D. Energy Kft., has entered into a definitive real estate sale and purchase agreement for the purchase of approximately 10,872 square meters of industrial land and photovoltaic infrastructure adjacent to the Company's operating solar facility in Kaposszekcső, Hungary.

slots.name: solar capacity
slots.sentence: With an operating 1.2 MWp solar facility already serving as the site's energy foundation, the additional property expands the physical footprint available to BrenX to evaluate additional renewable generation, battery energy storage systems ("BESS"), the Company's proprietary bGen™ TES technology, industrial energy services and, where appropriate, potential modular data center infrastructure.

slots.name: foundation count
slots.sentence: Under the definitive real estate sale and purchase agreement with Green Solartech Kft., A.R.D. Energy Kft. has agreed to purchase the adjacent industrial property together with 192 rammed pile foundations for solar module mounting structures, approximately 417 linear meters of industrial fencing and engineering documentation relating to the photovoltaic layout, grid connection and associated electrical infrastructure for an aggregate purchase price of HUF 58.3 million (approximately US $190,000) , plus VAT if applicable.
